Subject: Re: NorthBridge BCP evidence request: RPO discrepancies — artifacts attached

John / Kim — attaching the artifacts below and a short TL;DR on measurement methodology.

Attachments: runbook_snapshot-20261010.pdf (runbook excerpt showing KV cache warm steps), kv_cache_warm-20261010.tar.gz (extracted logs), rpo_test_summary-20261010.csv (per-sample RPO times)

TL;DR:
- The 1-minute RPO is the target for warm-standby (pre-warmed) failover where KV cache is kept hot via continuous replication and prefix caching.
- The October 10 execution was a warm-to-cold scenario (we intentionally included cold disk rehydration to validate durability). During that run, we observed RPO samples at 4–7 minutes because the KV cache had to be rebuilt and network bandwidth throttling for the cold rehydration was imposed to replicate real-world constraints.
- Measurement notes: RPO here is measured from detection timestamp (leader health poll) to first committed data visible in primary requester region; CSV includes sample_id, start_ts, commit_ts, rpo_seconds.

If you want a repeat of a pure warm-standby test (1-minute target), we can schedule one in us-west-2 with pre-warmed nodes and a tighter replication policy — that typically shows RPO < 60s.

Ben Carter

1) Artifact annotation — I’ll upload an annotated CSV (same filename with "-annotated") by tomorrow morning that tags each sample as warm-standby vs warm-to-cold and includes the run configuration (replication policy, pre-warm flag).
2) Advisory write-up — Marissa will post a one-page note summarizing when the 1-minute RPO applies and the operational pre-requisites (pre-warmed nodes, replication priority).
3) SOW amendment path — Ben and I can draft an addendum: two options for NorthBridge to choose from:

   - Option B (SLA change): Amend Annex A to make 1-minute RPO the baseline across all failure classes; this requires additional Reserved capacity and an SLA uplift. We can produce a cost estimate and an amortized lead-time for change.

4) Next-week call — propose Tue 2026-10-19 10:00 PT for a short 30-minute alignment call (Ben + Marissa + procurement + John). Please confirm.

Links and attachments: amended-sow-draft.docx (initial language for Option A), Drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNB-BRCP-ARTIFACTS
